implementation.fontPolicy: Inherit the platform system font through Qt.
implementation.qualification: Windows visually verified; macOS and Linux qualification pending.

focus.treatment: Two-pixel accent border on focused buttons, combo boxes, line edits, table and path field.

breakpoints.name: dedicated-details
breakpoints.behavior: Below this window width, show Details action and hide inline inspector and Source column.

elevation.strategy: Flat tonal surfaces with borders; no custom shadows.

extensions.previewPolicy: Native Qt components are documented in DESIGN.md. No HTML/CSS facsimiles are supplied.

keyCharacteristics: Compact task-focused pages with persistent navigation.
System appearance with explicit Light and Dark overrides.
Flat surfaces, restrained blue emphasis and visible keyboard focus.
Contextual details and recoverable feedback without routine modal interruption.
dos: Do use implemented theme roles, inherited system typography and compact spacing.
Do preserve visible focus, readable state words and recoverable feedback.
Do qualify all three native platforms before claiming visual parity.
donts: Don't add marketing headers, dashboard statistics or decorative cards to the approved Profiles workspace.
Don't infer successful sign-in or identity from a launch request.
Don't introduce custom fonts, icon systems, shadows or motion absent from the implementation.
